d: Bihar men kal sushasan divas manaya jaega. ise lekar rajdhani patna sthit janta dal yunaited (JDU) pradesh karyalay men khas taiyariyan ki ja rahi hain. sushasan divas se ek din pahle jediyu pradesh karyalay men ret se 'sushasan babu' nitish kumar ki behad khubsurat tasvir banaee gaee hai, jo vahan aane vale netaon aur karyakartaon ke bich aakarshan ka kendr bani huee hai.
